title: 第13章 态度大变第14章 姜家族会
slug: 天域丹尊第5904章不堪一击
content_zh:
第十三章态度大变
“是什么人在闹事？”前往人字包间的路上，秦掌柜问伙计。
“禀告掌柜，是王家小姐王冰燕在宴请叶玄公子，还请了一些其他家族少爷小姐作陪。事情的起因似乎是在座的一个无名小卒不知好歹，惹恼了他们。”
一听说惹事的是无名小卒，秦掌柜心里便有了数。叶玄是叶家最重视的嫡系子弟，而和他对上的则是一个无名小卒，傻子也知道应该站在谁那一边。
很快，秦掌柜进入人字包间。
望了一眼包间内凌乱的场面，秦掌柜忍不住暗暗皱了一下眉头，随即又恢复正常。
叶玄身边的周荣，见秦掌柜进来，便指着包间内的苏尘道：“掌柜的，你来得正好，此人在包间内打伤王腾，你醉仙居不会坐视不管吧？”
秦掌柜望了叶玄一眼，又扭头看了一眼苏尘身上那普普通通的穿着，便呵呵一笑，双手拢在袖里，笑容可掬的打圆场道：“好说，好说，各位稍安勿躁。”
说实话，以秦掌柜和安阳郡王府的关系，其实不需要放低姿态去讨好叶玄。
但他毕竟是生意人，自然也不会轻易驳叶家的面子。
更何况，有人在醉仙居打伤了人，这种事醉仙居本来就不能不管，更不用说打伤人的只是一个看起来普普通通没有任何背景的家伙。
当下，秦掌柜对身后的几名人高马大的武卫使了个眼色。
那几名武卫周身便散发出逼人的压迫感，朝苏尘走去。
姜婷宜霍的站起来，挡在苏尘前面，道：“事情明明就是王腾挑起的，你们醉仙居就是这么不分青红皂白的办事么？”
周荣凶悍道：“少废话！苏尘打断了王腾一条腿，我们都是亲眼看见的，这笔账他必须要还！”
“苏尘？”
耳尖的秦掌柜，一下子捕捉到那少年话语中的名字，不由得心中一动。
刚才在天字包间，惜灵郡主所说的恩人，不就是一个叫苏尘的年轻人吗？
眼看到几名武卫就要走到苏尘面前，秦掌柜连忙发话阻止：“等一下！”
其目光，停留在苏尘身上，内心迟疑。真有这么巧的事？还是仅仅同名同姓而已？

“少年，你叫苏尘？”秦掌柜试探问道。
苏尘点了一下头。
“今天上午在五宝堂，你是否出手给一位老者诊治过？”秦掌柜问出这句话，自己心里都觉得不太可能，郡主口中的恩人刚好也在醉仙居吃饭，哪有这么巧的事，应该只是凑巧同名同姓吧。
但，让秦掌柜吃惊的是，苏尘云淡风轻的回答：“你说那名被寒心蟒咬伤的老者？是我诊治的。”
是他！
居然真的是他！
秦掌柜并不怀疑苏尘是冒充，因为一个冒充的人是不可能知道老者的伤势是寒心蟒咬伤的。
“掌柜，你跟这家伙拉什么家常？给我狠狠打啊！”周荣见秦掌柜迟迟没有动手，反而开始和苏尘东拉西扯，不由得不耐烦起来。
但，让周荣没想到的是，平常一贯温和可亲的秦掌柜，此刻竟然一改常态，冷冷看了他一眼，沉声道：“我与贵客说话，请你闭嘴！”
贵客？
谁？
周荣愣在原地，不明所以。
而秦掌柜则是深吸一口气，立刻快步走向苏尘！
content_en:
Chapter Thirteen A Big Change in Attitude
"Who is making trouble?" Shopkeeper Qin asked the waiter on the way to the herringbone private room.
"Report to the shopkeeper that Wang Bingyan, the young lady of the Wang family, is hosting a banquet for Young Master Ye Xuan, and has also invited some young masters and ladies from other families to accompany him. The cause of the matter seems to be that an unknown person present here did not know what to do and annoyed them."
As soon as he heard that the troublemaker was an unknown person, Shopkeeper Qin knew something. Ye Xuan is the most valued direct descendant of the Ye family, and the person facing him is a nobody. Even a fool knows whose side to side with.
Soon, shopkeeper Qin entered the herringbone private room.
Glancing at the messy scene in the private room, shopkeeper Qin couldn't help but frown secretly, and then returned to normal.
Zhou Rong, who was next to Ye Xuan, saw shopkeeper Qin coming in, and pointed at Su Chen in the private room and said: "Shopkeeper, you came just in time. This man injured Wang Teng in the private room. You, Zuixianju, won't sit idly by and watch, right?"
Shopkeeper Qin glanced at Ye Xuan, then turned to look at Su Chen's ordinary clothes, then he laughed, put his hands in his sleeves, and said with a smile: "It's easy to talk, easy to talk, everyone, please be patient."
To be honest, with the relationship between shopkeeper Qin and the Prince of Anyang County, there is no need to lower his profile to please Ye Xuan.
But he is a businessman after all, so naturally he will not refute the Ye family's face easily.
What's more, someone hurt someone in Zuixianju. Zuixianju couldn't ignore this kind of thing in the first place, not to mention that the person who hurt someone was just a guy who looked ordinary and had no background.
At that moment, shopkeeper Qin winked at the tall and powerful military guards behind him.
Those military guards exuded an overwhelming sense of oppression and walked towards Su Chen.
Jiang Tingyi stood up in a hurry, stood in front of Su Chen, and said, "Wang Teng was clearly the instigator of the incident. Is this how you, Zuixianju, do things indiscriminately?"
Zhou Rong said fiercely: "Stop talking nonsense! Su Chen broke Wang Teng's leg. We all saw it with our own eyes. He must pay back this debt!"
"Su Chen?"
Shopkeeper Qin, who had sharp ears, suddenly caught the name in the young man's words, and couldn't help but feel moved in his heart.
Wasn't the benefactor Princess Xiling mentioned in the Tianzi private room just now a young man named Su Chen?
Seeing that several military guards were about to walk in front of Su Chen, shopkeeper Qin quickly said to stop them: "Wait a minute!"
His eyes stayed on Su Chen, hesitating in his heart. Is it really such a coincidence? Or is it just the same name?
"Young man, your name is Su Chen?" Shopkeeper Qin asked tentatively.
Su Chen nodded.
"Did you diagnose and treat an old man in Wubao Hall this morning?" When shopkeeper Qin asked this question, he felt that it was impossible. The benefactor mentioned by the princess happened to be eating at Zuixianju. How could it be such a coincidence? It was probably just a coincidence that he had the same name.
However, what surprised Shopkeeper Qin was that Su Chenyun replied calmly: "You said the old man bitten by the Cold Heart Python? I diagnosed and treated him."
It's him!
It's really him!
Shopkeeper Qin did not doubt that Su Chen was impersonating, because it was impossible for a pretender to know that the old man's injury was caused by the bite of the Hanxin Python.
"Shopkeeper, what are you doing with this guy? Give me a good beating!" Zhou Rong couldn't help but become impatient when he saw that Shopkeeper Qin didn't take action, but started talking to Su Chen.
However, what Zhou Rong didn't expect was that shopkeeper Qin, who was usually gentle and approachable, changed his mind at this moment, looked at him coldly, and said in a deep voice: "I'm talking to your distinguished guest, please shut up!"
Distinguished guest?
who?
Zhou Rong was stunned on the spot, not knowing why.
Shopkeeper Qin took a deep breath and walked quickly towards Su Chen!
